collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Two elders doze off and snore in turns like a tune: let the children make a song of it, or wake them with applause.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) have both dozed off in the shade after lunch, side by side, and both have begun to snore. Not together: in turns. One low, one high. One in, one out. It is almost a tune. A little group of children has gathered, sitting cross-legged in the grass, listening, enchanted.

choices.label: Let the Children Make a Song of It

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The children start tapping along on their knees, and then adding words. By the time the elders wake, the children have made a whole song, and they perform it with great ceremony. The elders are deeply puzzled and very flattered. The song is called "The Afternoon Song," and nobody ever tells them why.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: At a particularly fine moment, the children burst into applause. Both elders wake with a start. "What?" "What happened?" "You were singing," (child), a child, explains. The elders look at each other. Neither of them remembers singing. They decide, on balance, to accept the applause.
